title: Joseph Stalin sends the first advisers to China in an effort to repair the economic damage brought on by years of civil war.
text: Iosif Vissarionovich Stalin was a Soviet politician and revolutionary who ruled the Soviet Union from 1922 until his death in 1953, holding the titles of General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union from 1922 to 1952 and the nation's Premier from 1941 to 1953.
